description: MALAI: Read the user's daily nutrition targets from MALAI: calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, plus BMR and TDEE. MALAI calculates these from the user's profile and GLP-1 needs; use them exactly as given rather than calculating your own. Use when the user asks about their goals, their protein target, or whether an amount is enough.
name: malai_get_nutrition_targets

hasTargets.description: False when targets were never calculated; the other numbers are then absent.

title: Nutrition targets
